title: Serialize trade document item changes with header lifecycle and deletion
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement shared parent document lock and transactional header/item mutation protocol covering create/update/delete line plus header status/commercial update/delete/batch-delete. Resolve child parent with bounded read then recheck under lock; use deterministic sorted locks for batch. Under lock revalidate live authority, deletion/status eligibility, duplicate LineNo and server quantity/amount/unit rules; unknown/frozen statuses fail closed. Concurrent parent deletion or freeze must never accept a later line write. Preserve historical product snapshots and existing deliberate discrepancy behavior; no automatic header total rewrite or financial/inventory posting.

Real SQL two independent connections create/create same explicit line, automatic line numbering, item update/delete, status transition/create and header delete/create races with deterministic winning invariants and legal conflict loser. Failure rolls back all mutations/audit; restricted/revoked requests cannot modify. Keep original failure logs and integration fixtures isolated; unit existing snapshot/item/generation/print regressions plus safe Release, browser evidence or accurate blocker.
